name: fanzero
description: Publish games with FanZero and connect with content creators through launch visibility and revenue-share pacts.

interface.longDescription: Prepare a compatible game build, publish a reviewed listing on FanZero, and work with content creators through dated actions and revenue-share pacts. Publishing and revenue commitments stay under your approval. Includes a publishing skill; optional MCP connections are configured separately. Current uploads accept offline HTML builds or playable slices, up to 8 MB.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my game can be published on FanZero.
Prepare a FanZero listing and revenue-share offer for my approval.
Review my FanZero creator proposals and their revenue-share dates.

publication.release_notes: Initial publishing skill for Codex and Claude Code. Manual MCP recipes are distributed separately.
